title: Wake Me Up!
tagline: Wake up every morning to get back your money, if you don't wake up, your money is sent to SBF!
description:
This project helps you to wake up the morning:
1°) First you deposit some eth into a smart contract
2°) Then you define a wake up time for the week and the weekend
3°) Every day if you wake up before this time, you can claim a part of your deposit, if not this money is sent to Sam Bankman-Fried from FTX
4°) If you wake up 10 times in a row before your defined time, you can mint a NFT as gift/proof
how_its_made:
This project is simple but it is very easy to develop it or to custom it.
The main goal is to gamify the awakening in a fun way but with a real reason to wake up : Not lose money (it could be a pool between friends, and if you don't wake up, your friends earn your money, ...)
The idea comes from "Mode" sponsor who asked to be creative with the most weird and viral idea.
It's build with NextJS and Rainbowkit/wagmi, deployed on testnet of Base, Optimism, Mode and the NFT contract is on Zora testnet
The transaction to send money to Sam Bankman-Fried wallet is done manually but it could implement Chainlink automation
